data.content: # Latvia vs Montenegro Prediction: Montenegro will win their third consecutive round. ## Latvia vs Montenegro: Prediction for the match on 2 October 2026. On October 2, 2026, UEFA Nations League action will take place at the Skonto Stadium in Riga, where Latvia will host Montenegro. In the spring, the team won twice against Gibraltar, both 1-0, but in the Baltic Cup, they lost to Lithuania on penalties after a 1-1 draw (4-5), followed by a defeat to the Faroe Islands, 0-1. Their start in the current Nations League campaign has been lackluster, with a loss to Armenia, 0-2, followed by a goalless draw with Cyprus. A bet on Montenegro's individual total over 1.5 goals can be placed at odds of 2.15 with Betway. A bet on over 2.5 goals can be placed at odds of 2.15 with Paripesa. ## Match Prediction for Latvia vs Montenegro on October 2.

data.content: # Cyprus vs Armenia Prediction: Cyprus will secure their first win in the group. ## Cyprus vs Armenia: Prediction for the match on 2 October 2026. On October 2, 2026, UEFA Nations League action will take place at the GSP Stadium in Nicosia, where Cyprus will host Armenia. In the spring, they fell to Belarus 0-1 but bounced back with a 3-2 win over Moldova. Their current Nations League campaign began with a 2-0 win over Latvia, but they then let a lead slip in a 2-3 loss to Montenegro. You can bet on Cyprus to win at odds of 2.30 with 1xBet.
